web-guide-idea-14.audience: Food lovers who want to understand a neighbourhood through its dishes.
web-guide-idea-14.offer: Host a small food trail with explanations of ingredients, preparation and the people behind the stall. A clear route makes the event easy to follow.
web-guide-idea-14.steps.0: Ask vendors before filming and choose a few dishes.
web-guide-idea-14.steps.2: Describe flavours, share the vendor’s story and answer questions.
web-guide-idea-14.equipment: A phone and clean hands; a simple grip helps filming. Keep equipment away from hot oil and food preparation surfaces.
web-guide-idea-14.returnReason: Create neighbourhood or regional editions, giving each vendor and dish its own story.
web-guide-idea-14.promotion: Show one permitted preparation clip and list the dishes you plan to explore.

web-guide-idea-14.metadataDescription: Introduce local dishes and the vendors behind them, asking permission before you film. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
